lira.definition:
n. the basic unit of money on Malta; equal to 100 cents
n. the basic unit of money in Turkey
n. formerly the basic unit of money in Italy; equal to 100 centesimi

liras.definition:
n. the basic unit of money on Malta; equal to 100 cents
n. the basic unit of money in Turkey
n. formerly the basic unit of money in Italy; equal to 100 centesimi
liras.translation: n. （意大利和土耳其的货币单位）里拉( lira的复数形式 )

lire.definition:
n the basic unit of money on Malta; equal to 100 cents
n the basic unit of money in Turkey
n formerly the basic unit of money in Italy; equal to 100 centesimi
lire.translation: n. （意大利和土耳其的货币单位）里拉( lira的名词复数 )

lirella.definition:
n. A linear apothecium furrowed along the middle; the fruit
   of certain lichens.

liriodendron tulipifera.translation: [网络] 北美鹅掌楸；郁金香；美国鹅掌楸

liriope.definition: n sometimes placed in family Convallariaceae: lilyturf

liriope muscari.translation: [网络] 麦冬；阔叶山麦冬；短葶山麦冬

liripoop.definition:
n. A pendent part of the old clerical tippet; afterwards, a
   tippet; a scarf; -- worn also by doctors, learned men, etc.
n. Acuteness; smartness; also, a smart trick or stratagem.
n. A silly person.

liroconite.definition:
n. A hydrated arseniate of copper, occurring in obtuse
   pyramidal crystals of a sky-blue or verdigris-green color.
liroconite.translation: [化] 水砷铝铜矿; 豆铜矿
